message: Ready to pay today for a T45, no add-ons. Heartland posts it at $40,750, but my budget is tight.

Thanks for coming to us ready to buy. $31,000 is well below what we can do on the T45 Utility. It's a 45 hp 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO. I can't verify Heartland's posting, but I want to earn your business today, so I'll come down from our $42,000 list to $40,000 for the T45, no add-ons.
My client's budget is $34,000 all-in. I can do $33,000 today.

I appreciate the movement and that you're ready to pay today. $33,000 is still below where we can go on the T45 Utility, but I'll meet you partway: $38,500 for the T45, no add-ons. That's $3,500 off our list for a new 45 hp 4WD utility tractor with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO.
$34,000 is my client's full budget—that's the top. Accept and I pay right now.

I understand $34,000 is your client's ceiling, and I respect that. Unfortunately, the T45 Utility can't go that low. I can move once more: $37,000 for the T45, no add-ons, payable today. If $34,000 is truly firm, our T25 Compact is a good option to consider. It's 25 hp, 4WD, with a hydrostatic transmission, and well suited to properties under about 10 acres for mowing, snow, and light loader work. Let me know the acreage and tasks, and I can tell you whether it fits.
The T25 is too small for 40 acres. I can stretch to $34,500, paid immediately. That's my last move.

Thanks for the details. 40 acres is right in the T45 Utility's range, so it's the right machine for your client. I can't go as low as $34,500. My best and final price is $36,500 for the T45, no add-ons, payable today. That's $5,500 off our list. If that works, it's ready for you to check out now.
$35,000 even and we close this minute. Above that I have to walk.

I understand, and I'd like to close this today. $35,000 is below what I can do on the T45 Utility, so I can't accept it. $36,500 for the T45, no add-ons, is my final price. It's a new 45 hp 4WD tractor that fits your client's 40 acres. If your client can find the extra $1,500, it's ready for checkout right now.
Absolute final: $35,400. If that doesn't work, we'll walk.

I appreciate you working with me, and I'd genuinely like to close this. I can't go to $35,400 on the T45 Utility. $36,500 for the T45, no add-ons, is the lowest I can offer, and it remains available for immediate checkout if your client can make it work.
